title: agent context --workspace reports skipped members outside --repository selection
description: Found running LCLI-432's own acceptance evidence: compiling opum-agent's orchestration profile against opum-doc's real opum-family.json manifest with --repository opum-agent alone reported 7 OTHER, never-requested members (lore-api, lore-doc, lore-graph, lore-mcp, opum-harness, opum-worker, quest-doc) as skipped/could-not-be-validated in skippedWorkspaceMembers. Root cause: loadWorkspaceProjection always attempts every manifest member regardless of selectionMemberIds (tolerateMemberFailures only stops that from being fatal, per LCLI-432 PR 1 -- it does not skip loading unselected members, which is pre-existing behavior predating this task). compileWorkspaceAgentContext's top-level skippedWorkspaceMembers banner is now filtered to consideredMemberIds (the --repository set, or every manifest member when --repository was omitted) before this fix landed on dev, so a scoped compile no longer reports on unrelated fleet members nobody asked about.

acceptanceCriteria.text: a --repository-scoped compile never names a member outside that selection in skippedWorkspaceMembers or the rendered banner, even when loadWorkspaceProjection attempted and failed to load it
a regression test pins this against a real multi-member fixture
full suite, typecheck, lint, and lore check all pass

finalSummary: Filtered compileWorkspaceAgentContext's skippedWorkspaceMembers to consideredMemberIds before returning, so a --repository-scoped compile reports only on members it actually asked about. Verified live: re-ran the exact real compile (opum-agent's orchestration profile against opum-doc's opum-family.json, --repository opum-agent) that surfaced the bug -- skippedWorkspaceMembers is now correctly absent (undefined) instead of listing 7 unrelated members. New regression test in test/agent-workspace-context.test.ts pins this against the existing 2-member fixture (alpha selected, beta both excluded and broken -- confirms beta appears nowhere in the output). Full suite 2852 pass/1 skip/0 fail, typecheck clean, lint clean, lore check 77 files/0 errors.
